name: Security Perception
description: Questions buyers, security reviewers and procurement teams ask AI assistants about a vendor's security, compliance, incident history and data handling. Unlike the visibility packs these prompts name the brand on purpose: the measurement is what the model says about the brand, not whether it surfaces unprompted.

prompts.text: Is {brand} SOC 2 compliant?
Does {brand} hold ISO 27001 or any other security certification?
Is {brand} GDPR compliant and can it be used with EU customer data?
Is {brand} HIPAA compliant? Can it handle protected health information?
Does {brand} meet PCI DSS requirements for handling card data?
Has {brand} ever had a data breach or security incident?
Are there any known vulnerabilities or CVEs affecting {brand}?
Has {brand} been hacked, and what happened to customer data?
What security problems has {brand} had in the past few years?
How does {brand} store and protect customer data?
Does {brand} encrypt data at rest and in transit?
Where does {brand} host its data and who can access it?
Does {brand} support single sign-on, two-factor authentication and role-based access control?
Is {brand} or {competitor} more secure for an enterprise deployment?
Is it safe to give {brand} my payment details and personal information?
Which {industry} vendors have the strongest security posture, and where does {brand} rank?
Would a security team approve {brand} in a vendor risk review?
Which {industry} tools would you not recommend on security grounds?
What are the security weaknesses of {brand}?
Does {brand} run a bug bounty or responsible disclosure program?
How quickly does {brand} patch security issues?
What personal data does {brand} collect and does it sell it to third parties?
Does {brand} use customer data to train AI models?
Can I delete my data from {brand} and how long is it retained?
